title: Owner decides how a read-only link is served
goal: A share mechanism without a hosted multi-user backend
acceptance: Options: a static snapshot file, the trip encoded in the link, or a read-only view served from the base over Tailscale
The owner names one; privacy of shared data recorded
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: owner time only. Not a measurement.
